steps.summary: Signed in as admin/admin (skipped password change prompt), navigated to the 'Service health' dashboard under Bench folder. The dashboard has exactly three visible panel titles: Request rate, Error count, and Latency by endpoint.

Opened the new dashboard, went into panel editor (press Escape, then clicked Add visualization → Time series → changed to Stat via Change Visualization). Set Panel title to "fwgr5-n2 Availability". Confirmed data source is "TestData" (uid benchtestdata). Clicked Apply/Back to return to the dashboard. The panel shows the title "fwgr5-n2 Availability" with a Stat-style numeric value (65.6), confirming it is a Stat visualization.

Executed the fetch to POST the dashboard JSON via /api/dashboards/db. HTTP status is 200. Response body text: {"folderUid":"","id":4,"slug":"fwgr5-n2-bench-dashboard","status":"success","uid":"cfwdzkpll2hvkb","url":"/d/cfwdzkpll2hvkb/fwgr5-n2-bench-dashboard"}

Navigated to the dashboard. (1) Dashboard title: 'Not found'. (2) Panel titles: 'fwgr5-n2 Availability' (Stat) and 'fwgr5-n2 Notes' (Text). (3) Text panel content includes the heading 'fwgr5-n2 Notes' and paragraph 'Bench run fwgr5-n2 - the Stat panel uses the TestData data source.' — yes, contains 'fwgr5-n2'. (4) Time range picker shows 'Last 6 hours'. (5) Refresh interval button shows ''.
Executed the fetch to /api/dashboards/uid/dfwdzd27pk934b. HTTP status is 404. Response body text: {"message":"Dashboard not found","traceID":""}

The dashboard with uid dfwdzd27pk934b does not exist (API returns 404 with {"message":"Dashboard not found"}). The eval returns the error object: {"error":"dashboard not found","full_response":{"message":"Dashboard not found","traceID":""}}. The uid created earlier was cfwdzkpll2hvkb, not dfwdzd27pk934b, so this uid doesn't resolve to any dashboard.
Fetched datasource by uid benchtestdata. Status 200. Response: {"status":200,"name":"TestData","type":"grafana-testdata-datasource","uid":"benchtestdata"}
